subject: BluePeak customer advocacy call & prep materials
messages:
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
To: Lydia Park <lydia.park@bluepeak.com>, sales_ops@bluepeak.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BluePeak customer advocacy call & prep materials

Hi Lydia —

Thanks again for agreeing to speak with industry analysts about BluePeak's work with Redwood. Gartner reached out asking for a short customer call (30 minutes) to discuss the implementation and measurable outcomes. I looped in our CS lead (Laura) and AE (Ben) for logistics.

Would you be available for a 30-minute slot the week of Apr 12? Ethan from Gartner is flexible on morning slots PST. If you prefer, we can do a recorded Q&A instead of a live call.

Assuming a live call, the ask from Gartner is typically: background on use case, deployment timeline, perf/cost impact, internal adoption story, and a couple of metrics (latency improvements, cost per request savings). We can provide a one-page overview and a sample Q&A in advance.

Action items:
- Please share 2–3 time windows that week that work for you.
- Indicate whether BluePeak is comfortable with attribution (Gartner typically wants permission to quote company name).

Thanks again — this is a great chance to surface BluePeak's results.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

From: Lydia Park <lydia.park@bluepeak.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: sales_ops@bluepeak.com
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BluePeak customer advocacy call & prep materials

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for the note. We're happy to help; BluePeak has seen strong latency improvements since moving inference to Redwood, and our finance and platform teams will want to join.

Availability: Apr 13 (10:00–11:00 PT) or Apr 14 (09:30–11:00 PT). A 30-minute slot inside either window is fine. We prefer Gartner to attribute quotes to BluePeak (company name only, no executive quotes without approval).

A few logistical Qs:
- Can the call be recorded? Our legal team will want a heads-up if Gartner plans to publish verbatim quotes.
- We'll need a short prep deck or bullet doc to circulate internally — can you share a one-pager?

I'll copy sales_ops to coordinate calendar invites.

Best,
Lydia Park
VP, Platform Engineering | BluePeak Analytics

Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 08:30:00 -04:00

Hi all —

Thanks for the quick replies. Apr 14 at 10:00 PT works for Gartner — I've penciled that in for a 30-minute call (we'll keep it tight). Recording is fine, but we will flag any direct quotes to BluePeak for approval before publication; standard practice.

Prep from our side: I'll send a short pre-read (one pager) to help frame the discussion. For the call itself, the questions will be focused on:
- Business context and timeline
- Technical architecture (how Redwood was integrated)
- Quantitative outcomes (latency, cost per inference, throughput)
- Adoption/rollout and internal champions

If BluePeak can share the one-pager and any anonymized metrics in advance, that helps make the call productive.

Regards,
Ethan Shaw
Senior Research Analyst | Gartner
eshaw@gartner.com

Hi Lydia & team —

Great — confirmed: Apr 14, 10:00–10:30 PT (Google Meet link to follow from sales_ops). Attached are two quick files for internal review: BluePeak_Case_Overview.pdf (one-pager with bullets you can forward) and BluePeak_QnA_draft.docx (draft answers we typically use for analyst calls).

A few prep notes for BluePeak:
- Please highlight 2 concrete metrics (e.g., median latency pre/post, and estimated token cost reduction); if you can provide anonymized numbers that's ideal.
- If an engineer will speak to architecture, have a diagram or one slide showing where Redwood runs relative to your data plane.
- Gartner will ask about data residency and governance — short summary paragraph in the one-pager is enough.

If you'd like, Ben can join for the first 10 minutes to cover contract/implementation timeline.

Attaching files now. If you need any edits to the one-pager, we can turn around a revision by EOD Apr 8.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Laura Bennett
